stem_book: A kid of mass M stands at the edge (rim) of a platform of radius R and moment of inertia I (about its axis) which can rotate freely about its vertical axis. The platform with the kid is rotating in anticlockwise direction at an angular speed ω. The kid starts walking along the rim with a speed v relative to the platform, also in the anticlockwise direction. Find the new angular speed of the platform.
